location: Viña del Mar, Chile · Remote worldwide
summary: Hands-on Software Architect and Engineer with 13+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production systems. Founded and built Eleva, a multi-tenant SaaS platform developed end-to-end, from business workflows and application architecture to AWS infrastructure and automated delivery. At Electronic Payments, designed distributed, event-driven systems and introduced engineering practices that improved deployment reliability, auditability, and consistency across environments. I combine deep software engineering expertise with architectural ownership and a strong focus on delivering reliable systems that solve real business problems.
highlights: **Built a complete SaaS product:** founded Eleva and took it from idea to production as its sole architect and engineer, from business workflows to AWS operations. It won **Start-Up Chile Ignite (Generation 4) in 2022**.

**Architected a distributed commerce system:** designed Liquor Cart's event-driven integration between an AWS storefront and stores' on-premise registers, letting the business run online and in-store sales as one system.

**Changed how a company ships software:** introduced Electronic Payments' first CI/CD pipelines and environment parity from local to production. The resulting patterns became references reused by other projects.

experience.title: Lead Software Architect
bullets: Designed Liquor Cart as a **distributed, event-driven POS integration** using domain-driven design. Services exchange messages over RabbitMQ so paid online orders reach stores' on-premise registers in real time.
Introduced **event sourcing with Marten**, making the event store the source of truth for the catalog. Every business event is preserved, so product and price changes can be traced and audited.

Built the AWS middleware coordinating cloud services, existing POS systems and the Magento storefront, writing **about 90% of the C# code**. A dedicated RabbitMQ virtual host per store contains failures to one store.

Designed payment recovery for orders and payments that fall out of sync. Idempotent steps complete or cancel orders, void or refund payments, and escalate unresolved cases; retries and a replayable error queue cover the rest.

Introduced the **company's first CI/CD pipelines**, with CDK-defined infrastructure and parity across local, Dev, QA and Production. Releases became reproducible and consistent, with approval required before production.

These architectures and pipelines became **reference implementations reused by other projects**. Set engineering conventions and mentored a **six-person team**: 178 merged pull requests, 1,600+ unit tests on every push.

experience.title: Founder and Platform Architect
bullets: **Designed, built and took to production the entire SaaS platform**: frontend, backend, data model, AWS architecture, infrastructure, automation and operations. Eleva digitizes performance evaluation for schools.

Automates 360-degree evaluations with versioned rubrics that preserve the criteria behind each result, per-school multitenancy, access controls, evidence management, and traceable, reproducible evaluation processes.

Defined AWS infrastructure as code (CDK) with reproducible dev, QA and production environments and CI/CD with automatic ECS rollback: **19 production deployments in 30 days without failures**, each live in **about nine minutes**.

Keeps operating costs under control: the .NET application tolerates scheduled shutdowns, so ECS and RDS stop outside school hours. An operations panel shows configuration drift and traces each release to its commit.
Won **Start-Up Chile Ignite (Generation 4, 2022)**, which funded the move from prototype to product.
